mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(at.article_id) AS count, t.created_at AS createdAt FROM tag t LEFT JOIN article_tag at ON t.id = at.tag_id LEFT JOIN article a ON at.article_id = a.id AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.created_at ORDER BY count DESC, t.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_tag at INNER JOIN article a ON at.article_id = a.id AND a.status = 1 WHERE at.tag_id = #{tagId}
